title: Register for the December 7 Webinar on pdb_extract
content: Training News 2026 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Register for the December 7 Webinar on pdb_extract 09/01 Register for the December 7 Webinar "Streamline Deposition of Multiple Structures with pdb_extract" ' class='img-responsive' style=''> Register for the December 7 Webinar "Streamline Deposition of Multiple Structures with pdb_extract" Want to save time when depositing multiple structures to the Protein Data Bank? The newly redesigned pdb_extract pre-deposition service streamlines the preparation of structure depositions by helping users: Generate deposition-ready structure files in PDBx/mmCIF format Parse diffraction data processing log files to automatically extract reflection statistics Create reusable metadata templates for deposition of multiple structures across all major experimental methods, or retrieve metadata from existing PDB entries for reuse Review the prepared files for deposition readiness Join Dr. Chenghua Shao for a webinar on this pre-deposition service for preparing reusable metadata file and structure files for efficient deposition of multiple PDB structures. After the webinar, users will be able to: Use the pdb_extract web service to accelerate deposition of multiple structures Use the pdb_extract command-line tools for automated batch processing of multiple structures Understand the PDB deposition process and requirements, and best practices for efficient structure deposition The webinar is intended for: Researchers preparing to deposit structures to the PDB Current or former pdb_extract users interested in learning about new features and enhancements Anyone seeking a better understanding of the PDB deposition process and associated requirements Streamline Depositions of Multiple Structures with pdb_extract will take place Monday December 7, 2026 1 - 2pm Eastern | 10am - 11am Pacific. Please register for this free event. An institutional email address for registration is preferred. You will receive confirmation and a Zoom link by email before the event.
